question: 6 × (4 × 5²) ÷ 3 + 7 - 8 = ?
solution:
Given:

6 × (4 × 52) ÷ 3 + 7 - 8

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36648f6d9fd5d1d56959b630c72b514ab488f27d2525de3370bb428cc41cf8e9.png] 

Calculation:

6 × (4 × 52) ÷ 3 + 7 - 8

⇒ 6 × (4 × 25) ÷ 3 + 7 - 8

⇒ 6 × 100 ÷ 3 + 7 - 8

⇒ 6 × 100/3 + 7 - 8

⇒ 200 + 7 - 8

⇒ 199

∴ The simplified answer is 199.
